hypothesis: The fixed 0-2 annotation boundary creates false-negative supervision: a label selected by either independent annotator but omitted from the adjudicated final set is uncertain rather than a reliable negative. Masking only those negative BCE terms should improve transfer without changing positives, data, sampling, model, threshold, selector, or evaluation.
trainingData: The unchanged 841 aligned Train rows plus the unchanged audited 204-row GoEmotions targeted tranche
onlyChange: For the 841 aligned rows only, mask a negative label loss when that label was selected by Pass A or Pass B but is absent from the locked final label set. All locked final positives and all other negatives remain standard BCE; all GoEmotions rows remain hard-label standard BCE.
selection: One predetermined legal-149 Dev evaluation after the single epoch; PROMOTE only if Macro-F1 exceeds 0.34517932280540936 and Micro precision is at least 0.50.
